name: Configuration failure
description: The run is set up wrong (unknown environment/browser, missing secret, invalid value): fix the configuration, not the test
messageRegex: (?s).*(Unknown environment|Unknown browser|Unknown execution mode|Unknown parallel mode|Missing configuration file|Configuration '[^']*' (is not set|is not a valid|must be)|retry\.count must be).*

name: Infrastructure failure
description: Browser, Grid or network failed: not a result about the application
messageRegex: (?s).*(SessionNotCreated|NoSuchSession|UnreachableBrowser|Connection refused|connection reset|chrome not reachable|Could not start a new session|Unable to receive message from renderer).*

name: Timeout
description: An explicit wait expired: the expected state never appeared (slow application or changed UI)

name: Authentication / authorization failure
description: A call was rejected with 401/403 (or accepted where it should have been): sign-in, token or role problem
messageRegex: (?s).*(Expected HTTP \d+ but got 40[13]|Expected HTTP 40[13] but got \d+).*

name: Database failure
description: A database check or query failed: stored data differs from what the API/UI reported, or the query itself failed

name: UI failure
description: A UI check failed or a page/component could not be used

name: API failure
description: An API check failed: status, contract (schema) or payload differs from the expectation

name: Assertion failure
description: Any other failed check: the application did not behave as expected

name: Test or framework error
description: The test or framework itself threw an unexpected exception
